描述_EN: in addition to bolts of cloth, court robes were often sent from china to tibet in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries where they were refitted into a style of dress worn by lay aristocrats. close examination of the dragons on the upper part of this robe reveals that parts of their bodies do not match precisely, which suggests that this garment was either made from a larger one or pieced together from different robes. such reworking illustrates the value awarded to chinese textiles in tibet at the time.
描述_ZN: 除了布疋，宫廷长袍在十八和十九世纪经常从中国被送到西藏，在那里它们被改装成非专业贵族穿的衣服样式。 仔细观察这件袍子上部的龙，发现它们的部分身体并不完全吻合，这表明这件衣服要么是由一个更大的袍子制成，要么是由不同的袍子拼接而成。 这种再加工说明了当时西藏对中国纺织品的重视。
